-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [RegistroPago] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_RegistroPago_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Documento_Id AS INT = 0, 
@CuentaReceptora_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @RegistroPagoFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		RegistroPago_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @RegistroPagoFilter (RegistroPago_Id)
		SELECT 
			[RegistroPago].Id
		FROM [dbo].[RegistroPago]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[RegistroPago].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @RegistroPagoFilter (RegistroPago_Id)
		SELECT 
			[RegistroPago].Id
		FROM [dbo].[RegistroPago]
		WHERE
			 (([RegistroPago].[Documento_Id] = @Documento_Id) OR (@Documento_Id = 0)) AND
         (([RegistroPago].[CuentaReceptora_Id] = @CuentaReceptora_Id) OR (@CuentaReceptora_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[RegistroPago].[Id],
		[RegistroPago].[Folio],
		[RegistroPago].[Serie],
		[RegistroPago].[Documento_Id],
		[Documento].[Folio],
		[Membresia].[ClaveMembresia],
		[CuentaReceptora].[Nombre] AS [Cuenta],
		[RegistroPago].[ImportePagado],
		[RegistroPago].[SaldoAnterior],
		[RegistroPago].[SaldoInsoluto],
		[RegistroPago].[CuentaReceptora_Id],
		[RegistroPago].[Timbrado],
		[RegistroPago].[Fecha],
		[RegistroPago].[SolicitudTimbrado],
		[RegistroPago].[RespuestaTimbrado]		
		
	FROM @RegistroPagoFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[RegistroPago] 
			ON [RegistroPago].[Id] = filter.[RegistroPago_Id] 			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Documento]
		ON [dbo].[RegistroPago].[Documento_Id] = [dbo].[Documento].[Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Membresia]
		ON [dbo].[Documento].[Membresia_Id] = [dbo].[Membresia].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[CuentaReceptora]
		ON [dbo].[RegistroPago].[CuentaReceptora_Id] = [dbo].[CuentaReceptora].[Id] 

 
END
-- END OF [dbo].[cgp_RegistroPago_Index]
Name: rpt_RegistroPago_Index
